### 01.

```{r}
data <- data.frame(
  X = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10),
  Y = c(30, 40, 40, 50, 80, 60, 60, 60, 70, 120)
)
head(data)

model <- lm(Y ~ X, data = data)
summary(model)
model_diag <- ls.diag(model)
model_st <- cbind(
  model_diag$hat, model_diag$std.res, model_diag$stud.res, model_diag$cooks
)
colnames(model_st) <- c("Hii", "ri", "ti", "Di", "p-value")
model_st

library(car)
outlierTest(model)
```
